prompt: What is the exact value of $\tan 45^\circ$?
hint: A $45$-$45$-$90$ triangle has two legs of the SAME length.

hints.text: A $45$-$45$-$90$ triangle has two legs of the SAME length.
Tangent is opposite over adjacent, and here those two legs are equal.
Equal legs make the ratio $\frac{1}{1} = 1$, so $\tan 45^\circ = 1$.

explanation: A $45$-$45$-$90$ triangle is an isosceles right triangle, so its two legs are equal.
Tangent is $\frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}$, and both of those are legs of the same length.
Any number divided by itself is 1, so $\tan 45^\circ = 1$.

alternativeExplanations.title: As a slope
steps: Tangent of an angle is the slope of a line making that angle with the horizontal.
A $45^\circ$ line rises 1 for every 1 it runs, which is a slope of exactly 1.
